top_signals.title: Seoul Demands Ukraine Apology Over North Korea POW Disclosure
top_signals.summary: Seoul demanded an official apology and explanation from Kyiv, accusing Ukraine of violating an agreement to keep confidential the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Brazil's Energy Mix Goes Green Even As Oil Production Climbs
top_signals.summary: Brazil is continuing to expand its renewable energy capacity thanks to favourable national policies and support from foreign investors. The South American giant has developed an impressive green energy industry in recent years, expanding its oil and gas production to strengthen energy security and establish its reputation as a regional energy hub. By 2025, Brazil had an impressively low-carbon energy mix, with around 50 per cent of its energy coming from renewable sources, including solar, wind, and bioenergy. Brazil has achieved this diversification…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Bitget hacker moves $83 million in stolen XRP that Ripple cannot freeze
ShinyHunters uses WAF bypass trick in Oracle PeopleSoft attacks
top_signals.summary: The ShinyHunters extortion gang is using a URL-encoding trick to bypass web application firewall rules that mitigate the Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 flaw, allowing the threat actors to resume widespread exploitation of a flaw on vulnerable servers. [...]
